_note: Gaps found while porting design/marketing/Inspiration.dc.html to /inspiration. The extracted seeds gave the page its hero, collections heading and final-CTA copy, but every string the design's DCLogic held in JavaScript literals had no CMS home: the three filter control labels (Room / Style / Sort), the two 'show everything' option labels ('All' and 'All styles'), the three sort option labels (Most popular / Newest / A–Z — the labels are copy, the ordering itself is behaviour keyed off sort_option_* and stays in the component), the like button's accessible name, and the two words the mono count line assembles around live numbers ('ideas' and the ' · N liked' suffix). Blocks: the three curated collection cards land in `personas` group 'collections' (kicker = the mono lime count line, title = the card title, body = the description, cta_href = the matching project-type landing page, since the design's own href was a '#' placeholder), and the three final-CTA steps land in `steps` group 'cta-steps' (the 01/02/03 numerals are rendered from sort order like the landing page does, so they are not stored). The style filter's option labels are NOT seeded: the design's short styleOpts list (Modern/Scandinavian/…) has no counterpart on InspirationItem, which stores a longer per-item style ('Modern organic', 'Industrial warm'), so the select derives its options from the distinct style values the inspiration endpoint returns rather than from a literal array in the page. Room options likewise come from the endpoint's distinct tag values.
